notes: Release date: official announcement on 2025-09-05 (corroborated by contemporaneous coverage of the Moonshot announcement; HuggingFace repo createdAt 2025-09-03T03:34:36Z = weights uploaded two days before the announcement). No dedicated kimi.ai/blog post exists for 0905: the current kimi.ai blog index (probed 2026-09-01) lists only agent-swarm, kimi-k2, kimi-k2-5, kimi-k2-6, kimi-k2-thinking, kimi-k3, kimi-vendor-verifier, perception-bench, worldvqa, so the HF official model card serves as the dated A-tier release source; the K2 blog banner 'Update(0905)' also points at this refresh. Rare protocol disclosure: all K2-Instruct-0905 numbers are mean +/- std over five independent full-test-set runs; before each run the repository is pruned so every Git object unreachable from the target commit disappears (the agent only sees code legitimately available at that point in history). Except for Terminal-Bench (Terminus-2), results use the in-house SWE-agent-derived harness with clamped Bash/Edit context windows and rewritten system prompt. Asterisked baselines are excerpted from official reports/leaderboards; unmarked baselines were re-evaluated by Kimi under identical conditions. SWE-Dev adds file-overwrite + test-deletion hardening. Recommended deployment temperature 0.6 (deployment guidance, not eval protocol). Table columns: K2-Instruct-0905 | K2-Instruct-0711 | Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct | GLM-4.5 | DeepSeek-V3.1 | Claude-Sonnet-4 | Claude-Opus-4.
